# PawnIO.Modules — IntelMSR

`IntelMSR.bin` is the signed `IntelMSR` module from
[PawnIO.Modules](https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules) release
[0.2.11](https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/releases/tag/0.2.11),
unmodified. TaskbarMonitor embeds it as a resource and loads it into the
[PawnIO](https://pawnio.eu/) driver to read the package temperature and RAPL
energy MSRs.
